payload.name: Ask What Ozone Already Owns First
payload.description: Before adding, porting or rewriting anything, test whether Ozone-Studio already owns the role. Keep only what Ozone lacks, and retire what has a named Ozone owner.

principles.name: Do not recreate Ozone
principles.description: Stripping model calls and keeping the machinery around them rebuilds what Ozone already does.

principles.name: Geometry is shared
principles.description: Geometry is intrinsic to nodes and relations span graphs; it is not a per-modality extra.

heuristics.condition: a rewrite reintroduces reasoning, extraction or recovery code
heuristics.action: stop and map each part to Ozone's owner

decision_rules.name: Run the taxonomy test
decision_rules.condition: code from outside or from legacy is proposed for porting
decision_rules.outcome: ask for each module whether Ozone already owns the role (reasoning, traversal, multi-pass, recovery, extraction, schema) and keep only what it lacks

decision_rules.name: Name the Ozone owner
decision_rules.outcome: name the Ozone component that owns its role

decision_rules.name: Start fresh over carrying baggage
decision_rules.outcome: prefer a README-first, Ozone-first design to adapting legacy structure

decision_rules.name: Do not call constants analysis
decision_rules.condition: an output is described as analysis
decision_rules.outcome: verify its values differ across inputs; a constant or stub is not analysis
